verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a Computer Use feature in which ChatGPT can see and operate graphical user interfaces on macOS and Windows, including testing desktop apps and iOS simulator flows. The desktop app can also 'use your computer' and work on local resources, and data controls cover the screenshots Computer Use takes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Computer Use works in practice, and documentation of how users approve or limit the actions it takes on their apps.
